Thousands Stranded as Navyug Tunnel Traffic Halted in Jammu and Kashmir

Traffic was halted for Jammu-bound vehicles near the Navyug Tunnel in Jammu and Kashmir, leading to the stranding of thousands of passengers. The exact cause for the halt was not specified in the provided coverage. This disruption impacted a significant number of travelers in the region.
